svg.title: Peeled skin showing dragon scales, on tan skin, in five pictures, light from the top left. 1: a dashed outline of a torn, ragged shape. 2: green scales painted inside it. 3: the peeled flap of skin curled back over the top-right edge, a little paler on its underside. 4: a shadow inside the top-left edge of the hole and a soft cast shadow under the flap. Done: a light line along the fold of the flap and along the bottom-right torn edge.
